post.description:
Send a transactional email. The referenced Template's current content is
rendered with the supplied variables at send time. Respects the workspace
Suppression list (a suppressed destination returns status `suppressed`) but
not marketing Unsubscribe — transactional mail carries no sending source.

Supply an `Idempotency-Key` to make retries safe: a repeated key replays the
original result without sending a second email, and a key whose first request
is still in flight returns 409.

AuditFilter.actorKind.name: actorKind

AuditFilter.from.name: from
AuditFilter.from.description: Only entries at or after this time

AuditFilter.ip.name: ip
AuditFilter.ip.description: Only entries from this client address

AuditFilter.requestId.name: requestId
AuditFilter.requestId.description: Only entries made under this request id

AuditFilter.targetId.name: targetId
AuditFilter.targetId.description: Only entries about the target with this id

AuditFilter.targetType.name: targetType

AuditFilter.to.name: to
AuditFilter.to.description: Only entries strictly before this time

name.description: The label to apply; created on first use

ApplyTagInput.description: Request body for applying a tag to a contact

kind.description: The kind of actor; an operator is shown as "sphericon staff"

id.description: The actor's id (a User id or an API token id); absent for the system

name.description: Display name snapshot taken when the entry was written

AuditActor.description: The actor of an Audit entry

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last page

AuditEntryList.description: A page of Audit entries, newest first

diff.description: Before/after of the changed fields; secrets appear as changed only

userAgent.description: Client user agent of the change

name.description: Name snapshot taken when the entry was written; absent for a Contact

AuditTarget.description: What an audited change was done to

triggerEvent.description: Event action that enrolls a contact (e.g. "contact.created", "email.opened")

AutomationResource.description:
An Automation: an event-triggered, ordered sequence of steps. Created
automations are always draft; activating is a separate, send-class operation.

seconds.description: Delay before the next step, in seconds (wait steps)

tag.description: Tag name to apply to or remove from the enrolled contact (apply_tag and remove_tag steps)

AutomationStep.description:
One node in an automation's ordered, linear sequence. A flat shape: email
steps carry subject/body, wait steps carry seconds, tag steps carry the tag name.

holdReason.description:
Why sending is currently held, when it is: `workspace_suspended`,
`unverified_domain` or `no_integration`. A hold is reversible, not a failure.

sentCount.description: Messages handed to the email provider

skippedCount.description: Recipients skipped at send time (unsubscribed or suppressed after planning)

unsubscribedCount.description: Recipients that unsubscribed via this broadcast

fromName.description: Sender display name (defaults to the integration's)

fromEmail.description: Sender email address (defaults to the integration's)

segmentId.description: Audience: the Segment this broadcast goes to; null means all active contacts

status.description: Lifecycle status. Broadcasts created here are always drafts.

scheduledAt.description: When the broadcast is scheduled to send

index.description: Zero-based position of the item in the request

status.description: created or updated on success; failed when the item was rejected
